description: Approved exception for a corporate sign-in provider that does not send the email_verified claim (G-160, security opinion AJA-212). One provider and one organisation per record. A record never changes after approval and is never deleted: a change opens a new record that supersedes the old one, and a revocation record ends the exception. The record holds no secret.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: A grant opens an exception. A revocation ends the current grant.

fields.label: Provider Alias
fields.description: The identity provider alias in Keycloak. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

fields.label: Issuer
fields.description: The provider's own https issuer. A shared issuer such as Microsoft's common is refused. Required for a grant.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: The one organisation of this exception. The organisation record does not exist yet, so the field keeps its identifier.

fields.label: Supersedes
fields.description: The record this one replaces. Empty only for the first record of a provider and organisation.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the provider does not send email_verified, or why the exception ends.

fields.label: Provider Document
fields.description: The https address of the provider document. Required for a grant.

fields.label: Expires On
fields.description: Required for a grant. There is no default: the length is a product decision.

fields.label: Allowed Domains
fields.description: The verified email domains that may sign in through this provider. Required for a grant.

fields.label: Requested By
fields.description: Filled with the user who opened the record.

fields.label: Approved By
fields.description: Filled by the approval endpoint. Never the requester, never an agent.

fields.label: Approval Principal
fields.description: The identity type of the approval request. Only a human session counts.

fields.label: Approved On
fields.description: Filled by the approval endpoint with the time of the approval.

name: PLT Enterprise IdP Exception
